best.why: Trading early rolls leftover balance into the new loan.
best.guard: Soft offer: let the customer pick the timing.

opts.name: Keep the loan as is
opts.sum: Keep paying $540/mo for 8 more months. About $110 of interest remains.

opts.name: Refinance with Toyota Financial Services
opts.ok: N (new rate not meaningfully lower; fewer than 12 months left; balance under $8,000)
opts.sum: A new rate of 7.40% would not lower the cost.

opts.name: Extend term by 12 months
opts.sum: Lower payment to $224/mo (-317) but pay about $149 MORE in total interest.

opts.name: Pay $100 extra per month
opts.sum: Paying $640/mo finishes 1 month sooner and saves about $15 in interest.

opts.name: Move payment due date
opts.sum: Move the due date to match payday. Same payment, same total cost. Done in the app in about a minute.

opts.name: One-payment deferral (hardship)
opts.sum: Skip one payment. About $24 of interest is added and the loan ends 1 month later.

opts.name: Trade in toward a new Toyota
opts.sum: Estimated value $15,550 vs payoff $4,214: equity of $11,336.

opts.name: Book service + recall fix
opts.sum: Book a service visit in the Toyota app. Toyota Care coverage status is shown before you book.
